summary: Esper dungeon reanimator: mill or sac a creature each turn so Sefris ventures, then complete floors to loot the graveyard onto the battlefield.

tags.name: dungeon
tags.reason: The repeating action is venturing and completing dungeons.

tags.name: reanimator
tags.reason: Sefris, Animate Dead, Victimize, and From the Catacombs win by returning creatures.

tags.name: graveyard
tags.reason: Creature cards in the yard are both the venture trigger and the loot pile.

tags.name: self-mill
tags.reason: Stitcher's Supplier, Buried Alive, and loot effects fill the yard on purpose.

tags.name: aristocrats
tags.reason: Sac outlets feed Sefris; they are not a drain engine.

tags.name: cats
tags.reason: Donut package exists, but cats are not the win.

tags.name: blink
tags.reason: Whitemane Lion, Ephemerate, and Displacer Beast recast enter-venture creatures.

tags.name: midrange
tags.reason: The deck wins by assembling a board over many turns, not a combo dump.
